quests.title: Mutual Exchange

dialogue.t: Hmm, it appears that it wants an object of a specific color... Shall we go see what it wants?
See? Where there's a will to communicate, there's a way!
It said that its friend knows, and it's marked their location on the Map for us. Let's go find them!

dialogue.sit: I think we got it wrong...

quests.description: You go with Ella Musk to communicate with the hilichurls. Perhaps this might be the start of a new friendship…?
